items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: He had two trombones. He had Claude Jones and Benny Morton... He let Claude go and Benny and I worked together.

ctx.x: also and I was just wondering if they were playing with Fletcher Henderson at the same time or at different times?
He had two trombones. He had Claude Jones and Benny Morton... He let Claude go and Benny and I worked together.

Oh, that's it, they did work together. I saw the picture of them too in the book and I was wondering if that was - ... You were also telling us yesterday a little bit of how you reacted to trombone players such as Jay Jay Johnson, Benny Green, and their style. You said that their style was a little too technical to suit you?
